# Collective Moves

> Collective Moves is a Dallas-Fort Worth network that helps older adults and their families plan a later-in-life move: selling a longtime home, downsizing, estate sales, moving, choosing senior living, and the legal and financial planning around it, coordinated from one call.

Collective Moves was founded by Valerie Van Pelt, a Dallas native, REALTOR® with Compass Park Cities, and Seniors Real Estate Specialist® (SRES®). It works with senior living communities to offer free educational seminars, "Don't Wait, Plan Now," and connects families with trusted professionals as their timeline calls for them. Each professional provides services under their own license and business.

Service area: Dallas-Fort Worth, including Dallas, the Park Cities (University Park and Highland Park), Plano, Frisco, McKinney, Richardson, Addison, Allen, Garland, Irving, Arlington, Carrollton, and Fort Worth.

## Team

- Lori Olson: downsizing, space planning and moving
- Rebecca Davison, LMSW: estate and moving sales (Chickadee Lane Estate and Moving Sales)
- Kelley Novak: senior living navigator
- Dr. Leigh Richardson: brain performance specialist (Brain Performance Center®)
- Aaron Miller: estate planning attorney
- Jim Whiddon: financial planning
- Johnathan M. Whiddon, CFP®: associate wealth advisor
- Your Moving Butlers: white-glove moving service in collaboration with Collective Moves
